title: RO-Crate: the descriptor and datePublished rules, and the two-validator agreement
note: RC1-RC2 the internal validator's RO-Crate 1.1 REQUIRED items (D-2026-106); RC3-RC5 the agreement, not-measured and side-effect rules of the conformance tool.

mutations.name: RC1_conformsTo_unchecked

                "https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.") for c in conforms):
mutations.rationale: a descriptor naming no specification is valid

mutations.name: RC2_datePublished_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a root without datePublished is valid

mutations.name: RC3_agreement_assumed
mutations.rationale: a disagreement between the validators is reported as agreement

mutations.name: RC4_unmeasured_called_agreement
mutations.rationale: an external validation that did not run is reported as agreement

mutations.name: RC5_judging_overwrites_report
mutations.rationale: judging a broken crate overwrites the committed validation report
